opengl.script:
#!/bin/bash
source "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/omarchy-session.env"
base="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/pjz110-blender-terminal-opengl"
echo "Blender opengl test: $base.log"
blender --factory-startup --python /usr/lib/arlinux/blender-checks/workflow.py > "$base.log" 2>&1 &
app_pid=$!
printf '%s\n' "$app_pid" > "$base.pid"
wait "$app_pid"
rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$base.exit"
cat "$base.log"
echo "Blender exit: $rc"
exec /usr/bin/bash -i

printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$base.exit"
cat "$base.log"
echo "Blender exit: $rc"
exec /usr/bin/bash -i
